say:2:1013615001:1.text: I think this is a good spot to rest!
say:2:1013615001:1.source_cn: 就在这片遗迹广场休息一下吧，梅林大人？
say:2:1013615001:1.male: I think this is a good spot to rest!
say:2:1013615001:1.female: I think this is a good spot to rest!

say:4:1013615002:1.text: Ah, resting after a long journey feels amazing...
say:4:1013615002:1.source_cn: 呼！长途奔波后的休憩，真是舒服啊……

say:5:1013615003:1.text: Besides the travel, I've been thinking about a series of events that have occurred, and some things are puzzling.
say:5:1013615003:1.source_cn: 沿途除了赶路，我还想着发生的一系列事情，多少有点想不通。

say:6:1013615005:1.text: It seems reactivating the golems was just their temporary goal. But I can't figure out the link between the golems and their plan concerning the Sun Temple.
say:6:1013615005:1.source_cn: 嗯，重启魔偶似乎只是他们中途的目的。但我不明白魔偶与他...

say:7:1013615006:1.text: Before we left, we received a plea for help from the Sun Temple. But since the portal was destroyed, we had to rush from Holistone.
say:7:1013615006:1.source_cn: 在我们出发之前，圣堂收到日神殿的传信要求增援。但传送门...

say:8:1013615007:1.text: And about the sacred items in the Sun Temple? It's strange. Considering Soleih has long fallen, why would there still be sacred items there?
say:8:1013615007:1.source_cn: 而且，在日神殿的圣物？也颇有奇怪之处。毕竟日神早已陨落...

say:9:1013615008:1.text: Regardless, the Adamant Syndicate's objective appears to revolve around these sacred items. And it seems they've been planning for quite some time...
say:9:1013615008:1.source_cn: 但无论如何，黑金商会的目的疑似指向了圣物。而且，他们布...

say:10:1013615009:2.text: Dura above! I'm as nervous as it is! Let's all calm down... The more anxious we are, the more we must focus and conserve our strength!
say:10:1013615009:2.source_cn: 艾雅在上，特弥希娅，我和你一样着急……可越是着急，越要...

say:11:1013615010:2.text: Right. I can't afford to panic at this point.
say:11:1013615010:2.source_cn: 你说得对，卢修斯，多谢。事情已经到了现在这个地步，更不...

say:12:1013615011:2.text: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.
say:12:1013615011:2.source_cn: 梅林大人，卢修斯，你们快去休息吧。别的事明天再聊。
say:12:1013615011:2.male: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.
say:12:1013615011:2.female: Magister, Lucius, you both should rest. We can talk about other matters tomorrow.

say:15:1013615004:1.text: It'd be best to organize the information we've gathered while we have the time.
say:15:1013615004:1.source_cn: 啊。趁现在有空，还是整理一下已获得的情报比较好。

choice:3:1:2.text: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.
choice:3:1:2.male: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.
choice:3:1:2.female: Let's sort out all the clues we have so far.
